title: Pool Maintenance Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Facility Pool Maintenance: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Pool Maintenance Inspection Checklist covers pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area. The aquatics facility coordinator records Facility Pool Maintenance criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Pool Maintenance Inspection Checklist keeps Facility Pool Maintenance exceptions visible until the aquatics facility coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Pool Maintenance Inspection Checklist at pool vessel, equipment room, chemical storage, deck, and user-access point. Document pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area identity before Facility Pool Maintenance begins. Compare pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area findings with stated Facility Pool Maintenance criteria; route unresolved Facility Pool Maintenance issues to qualified pool-operations reviewer. For Pool Maintenance Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Facility Pool Maintenance. Ask qualified pool-operations reviewer to review Facility Pool Maintenance conditions beyond the aquatics facility coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Facility Pool Maintenance, identify responsible parties, pool vessel, equipment room, chemical storage, deck, and user-access point, and the linked pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area source.

fields.label: Operating target, prior reading, and service interval

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Facility Pool Maintenance facts for pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Facility Pool Maintenance inspection checks
items: Disinfectant, pH, temperature, and clarity reading
Circulation, filter pressure, flow, and leak condition
Chemical feed, container, labeling, and storage condition
Drain cover, barrier, gate, sign, and rescue-equipment observation
Deck, handrail, ladder, lighting, and trip condition
Controller alarm, dosing response, and retest result

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Facility Pool Maintenance finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Aquatics Facility Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Water quality or clarity outside operating criteria
Chemical leak, incompatible storage, or uncontrolled feed
Required closure or qualified review not implemented
Closure, correction, reopening, and notification record
blocks.guidance: Pause Facility Pool Maintenance when water quality, chemical control, circulation, visibility, or user-protection concern remains. Retain the available Facility Pool Maintenance proof and route unresolved pool, spa, circulation, filtration, disinfection, controls, and deck area scope to aquatics facility coordinator.
